about: FINAL V2.1 (GDD Edit 125): Story Map 2 as nine puzzles. Parkland. The learner: the VANGUARD™ POL-01-001, a police car (Edit 121). On the road: the certified LUMINARY™ SED-01-001, a white car with every sensor; from the Vanguard's rung 4 it reports what it sees. Set by hand. Edit 126: B1's garden drive (a U-turn north of the walkway, tile: 'B1' in world6); A3 and C3 built; parts spaced (Legs 1 at B1, Battery 2 at A3).

map.name: Parkland
map.title: MAP 2 · PARKLAND
map.intro: Parkland. The gardens, the reservoir, the ring. The Vanguard™ patrols; the Luminary™ you certified drives here now.

puzzles.name: Patrol
puzzles.tale: Parkland's patrol car. Police spec: it sees ahead and to the sides from day one.
puzzles.new: The Vanguard™: forward camera and side sensors from the start.
puzzles.newLine: Vanguard™ · sees ahead and to the sides
hints: Wait wide of its lane. Dash in as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: From open ground 148 off its lane, dash in as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: The Drive
puzzles.tale: A garden drive off the highway: down, round the turn, back up. The patrol takes it every lap.
puzzles.new: The turn: on a bend it looks along the curve, not at you.
puzzles.newLine: The turn · it looks along the curve
hints: Wait behind the hedge outside the turn. Dash in as it comes round.
puzzles.solution: Behind the hedge 150 off the bottom of the turn, crouched; dash north as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: K-Rail
puzzles.tale: The avenue is railed off. A running jump clears the rail.
puzzles.new: Legs 1: {X} jumps. A running jump clears a K-rail.
hints: Run at the rail. Jump just before it. Land ahead of its nose.
puzzles.solution: Run west at the K-rail; jump a stride before it; land in its lane as its nose nears.

puzzles.name: Underpass
puzzles.tale: The highway roofs the road. Its roof lidar sees you up on the deck.
puzzles.new: Watchtower: its lidar sees you on the deck.
puzzles.newLine: Lidar · it sees you up top
hints: Stay under the deck, not on it. Dash from the shade.
puzzles.solution: Under the deck, 150 off its lane: dash in as its nose nears.

puzzles.name: Ring Road
puzzles.tale: The Luminary™ you certified drives here now. It tells the Vanguard™ what it sees.
puzzles.new: Informant: the Luminary™ reports you. Seen by it, you are noticed at once.
puzzles.newLine: Luminary™ · it sees all round, it tells
hints: Wait while the Luminary™ is away. Dash when only the Vanguard™ comes.
puzzles.solution: Out of the Luminary™ ring, 150 off the Vanguard™ lane: dash as its nose nears.

puzzles.name: Overpass
puzzles.tale: Under the overpass, the Luminary™ on the other lane. Twice, please.
puzzles.new: Cordon: cones stop it now. Two hits.
hints: Wait wide of its lane. Dash in as it comes level. Then again.
puzzles.solution: West of its lane, 150 off: two dashes, two passes.

puzzles.name: The Bend
puzzles.tale: The wide bend under the belvedere. Out of the turn the Vanguard™ picks up speed along the garden.
puzzles.new: Out of the bend: it is fast and has eyes on its line.
puzzles.newLine: The bend · fast out of the turn
hints: Wait south of the road where the bend ends. Dash in as its nose comes level.
puzzles.solution: From open ground 150 south of the road east of the bend, dash north as its nose comes level.

puzzles.name: Crosstown
puzzles.tale: Crosstown, under the highway. It remembers where it crashed. The Luminary™ follows it.
puzzles.new: Casefile: it remembers every crash. Two hits.
hints: From the north, dash across the empty lane as its nose nears.
puzzles.solution: North of the westbound lane, 150 off its own: dash across as its nose nears, twice.

puzzles.name: Roundabout

objective.label: THREE HITS · A NEW WAY EACH

puzzles.tale: The street roundabout where the garden street meets the boulevard. Three hits certify the Vanguard™.
puzzles.new: A boss. It learns once, after your first hit.
puzzles.newLine: Boss · learns after your first hit
hints: Three hits, three places: the arm it comes in on, the far side of the ring, the arm again further in. After the first it searches where it lost you.
puzzles.solution: East of the SE arm as it comes in (dash NW); north of the ring (dash SE... see qa/solutions/parkland_C3.json); the SE arm again, further in.
